newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 25.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Bonded factories to be allowed to import Chinese products on May 1
-- China, Russia, and three other small countries, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan, sign pact on troop reductions along the former Sino-Soviet border
UNITED DAILY NEWS - First Taiwan ship sails directly to China in 48 years
-- Town mayor released on bail over alleged construction bribery scandal
LIBERTY TIMES - Vice Foreign Minister Chen Chien-jen quietly leaves for Europe
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Flag issue major topic in Hong Kong, Taiwan shipping talks
-- Fujian vice governor confirms start of Formosa Plastics group's thermal power project in Zhangzhou
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Finance ministry plans merger of two income taxes
-- March's M1B annual growth rate rises to 14.4 pct
